user.title: User Profile
user.description: Public profile and online status for a chat user.

uid.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

status.description: The current presence status of the user.

lastSeen.description: The last timestamp when the user was verified active.

chat.title: Chat Room
chat.description: A conversation between two or more users.

type.description: Whether this is a 1-to-1 direct message or a group chat.

participantIds.description: List of user UIDs participating in this chat.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the chat room was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the chat room was last updated.

lastMessage.description: Data about the last message sent in this chat room.

isTyping.description: Map of user UIDs to booleans indicating who is actively typing.

message.title: Message
message.description: A single text or encrypted message within a chat room.

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

senderPhoto.description: Avatar image URL of the message sender.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

isEncrypted.description: Flag indicating if the message payload is end-to-end encrypted.

iv.description: Base64 encoded initialization vector for decryption.

salt.description: Base64 encoded salt used for PBKDF2 key derivation.

previewText.description: Unencrypted placeholder text (e.g. '🔒 Encrypted Message') for safe previews.

/users/{userId}.description: Lookup table for user profile information and online status heartbeat.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection containing the sequence of messages for a specific chat.
